what: First-time visitors only: over a single photo covering the screen, a vertical seal (season-letter logo) waits 2s and then rises over 2s, and .1s later the whole cover lifts away over 2s (curve power1.out). The moment lifting starts, fx:open fires and the Hero rises beneath it at the same time (overlapping melt opening, about 6.1s). .3s before the lift, the window scrolls to the top. If already seen this session, fx:open fires directly with no cover. fx:start fires the moment the cover turns on, so the hidden body is turned on then

options.[data-fx-part=seal]: Seal in the center of the cover (vertical logo image) — if absent, fx:open fires right away with no cover
options.wait: Wait before the seal appears (s), default 2
options.gap: Time until the cover lifts after the seal mark (sec), default .1
options.fade: Length of the cover lifting away (seconds), default 2 — shorten it for screens opened often
options.key: Name to record so it shows only once per session, default fx-seal-fade-opening

use: · document.addEventListener("fx:open", turn on Hero)

from.where: index.html .e-opening (original .opening — logo 2s delay 2 → opening 2s delay .1, homePageFadeIn is -=2, sessionStorage brandVisited)

note: The original curve is the GSAP default (power1.out). The original waits until photos and logo art have all loaded and skips ahead if they don’t arrive within 10s — the motion part starts as soon as it is attached
